method: In-process Windows Toolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPMODULE) module enumeration AFTER a real MIOpen workload (Conv2d fwd + BatchNorm2d train fwd/bwd + SGD step on cuda:0). Captures lazily-loaded runtime DLLs; not inferred from torch.__version__.

runs.note: env B restored to official DLL after patched-leg probe; hash-verified in-place

cross_run_consistency: Both runs used seed 0 and identical shapes; FP32 loss identical to 1e-15 (0.5002452731132507) — patched vs pre-fix DLL numerically consistent for this tiny workload (single-sample observation, NOT a general numerical-equivalence claim; the full matrix lives in G1).
limitations: Source-built DLL in env B logs CK grouped-conv symbol-resolution warnings and one fdb.txt unreadable warning in wheel context; documented as env-B known condition (does not occur with official DLL).
hipdnn plugin path: hipdnn_backend.dll loads with MIOpen as engine backend; conv/BN routed through MIOpen engine on this wheel stack.
